_meta.purpose: Per-product label interpretation table for magnesium transparency badges

oxide_MgO.factor_note: compound_mg = elemental_mg / 0.6031. IMPORTANT: for all 4 confirmed IL oxide products (Nutricare 520, Altman 520, Altman MagUP, Altman Balance), 520mg and 450mg are ELEMENTAL per NRV% arithmetic verification (TASK-384). Compound mass is back-calculated here for reference only.

bisglycinate_MgC4H8N2O4.factor_note: compound_mg = elemental_mg / 0.1410. Full-Mag label states compound=600mg directly; Nutricare WELL states 785mg compound/168mg elemental — use label two-line where available.

malate_MgC4H4O5_dibasic.formula: MgC4H4O5 (dibasic form commonly cited as 0.195 Mg fraction for scoring)
malate_MgC4H4O5_dibasic.factor_note: compound_mg = elemental_mg / 0.195. Reconciliation doc uses 700mg compound × 0.195 = 136.5mg for Nutricare Malate. Tink Malate label states 850mg compound/136mg elemental directly.

taurate_MgC4H12N2O6S2.factor_note: Label two-line confirmed: 950mg compound / 76mg elemental. Used label ratio, not chemistry formula.

hydroxide_MgOH2.factor_note: compound_mg = elemental_mg / 0.4167. NT LC label states 450mg compound / 190mg elemental directly.

carbonate_MgCO3_amorphous.factor_note: compound_mg = elemental_mg / 0.2883. Amorphicure label ambiguous — used for reference only.

7290001943700.compound_mass_note: label two-line confirmed: '600mg bisglycinate compound / 122mg elemental magnesium'. Compound 600mg bisglycinate (Albion USA) stated directly. Source: tevaworld.com, drugstore.co.il, vitamins4all.co.il (all HTTP 200). Cross-check stoichiometric: 122/0.1410 = 865mg — NOTE: this does not match the label 600mg. The discrepancy is because Albion chelated bisglycinate may use a different Mg% depending on chelation grade. The two-line label is authoritative; stoichiometric back-calculation is secondary.
7290001943700.source_wording: מגנזיום (ממגנזיום ביסגליצינאט Albion) 122 מ"ג — תרכובת 600 מ"ג
7290001943700.source_wording_origin: SKU corpus_correction field (TASK-384, 2026-06-23): 'Label reads 600mg bisglycinate compound / 122mg elemental magnesium'; tevaworld.com, drugstore.co.il, vitamins4all.co.il HTTP 200
7290001943700.note: Compound/elemental ratio (122/600 = 20.3%) diverges from standard bisglycinate stoichiometry (14.1%). This is expected for Albion chelated forms which carry a larger organic-salt mass per unit of elemental magnesium. The label two-line declaration is authoritative.

7290015318532.compound_mass_note: label two-line confirmed: '850mg malate compound / 136mg elemental'. Compound 850mg stated directly. Cross-check stoichiometric: 136/0.195 = 697mg (dibasic fraction). Discrepancy suggests monobasic malate form (Mg malate monobasic MW ~156 → 136/0.1554 = 875mg ≈ 850mg label). Label is authoritative.
7290015318532.source_wording: 850 מ"ג מגנזיום מלאט — 136 מ"ג מגנזיום אלמנטרי
7290015318532.source_wording_origin: magnesium_label_audit_v1.md row #11; bella-natura.net HTTP 200; SKU panel ingredient: 'מגנזיום (magnesium malate) 136mg'

7290001066973.compound_mass_note: label declares compound mass only: '700 מ"ג של מגנזיום מלאט' (700mg OF malate compound). Elemental derived: 700 × 0.195 = 136.5mg (reconciliation range: 133-137mg; midpoint 135mg used). No two-line elemental declaration on label.
7290001066973.source_wording_origin: magnesium_label_audit_v1.md row #4 (COMPOUND MASS declared); tevagil.co.il + maxpharm.co.il HTTP 200; SKU panel: 'מגנזיום (magnesium malate) 700mg'
7290001066973.note: Label declares compound mass 700mg; elemental derived by stoichiometry (×0.195). Range 133-137mg; midpoint 135mg used. No label-stated elemental figure — label_confidence חלקי.

7290018439579.compound_mass_note: label two-line confirmed: '950mg taurate compound / 76mg elemental'. Compound 950mg stated directly. 7290001065662.compound_mass_note: back-calculated: 520 / 0.6031 = 862.2mg MgO compound. The label declares 520mg as ELEMENTAL (per IL label convention 'ממגנזיום אוקסיד' = 'from magnesium oxide'; same format as citrate products). NRV% confirmation not available from maxpharm.co.il page (NRV column not displayed), but determination is ELEMENTAL by convention — identical format to Altman 520 which was NRV%-verified. CORRECTED from prior compound reading (was 314mg elemental = 520mg compound, now reversed).
7290001065662.source_wording_origin: SKU panel label_basis_verification.label_text_verbatim: 'מגנזיום (ממגנזיום אוקסיד) 520 מ"ג'; maxpharm.co.il HTTP 200; TASK-384 2026-06-23 convention-inferred (NRV% not retrieved from this source)
7290001065662.note: 520mg IS elemental (panel_verified_elemental via IL label convention + NRV% arithmetic for the category; direct NRV% not retrieved from maxpharm page but determination HIGH confidence per identical format to Altman 520 label-image-verified). UL_EXCEED: 520mg > 350mg IOM/NASEM supplemental UL.

7290017218564.compound_mass_note: back-calculated: 520 / 0.6031 = 862.2mg MgO compound. Label declares 520mg ELEMENTAL per '(From Magnesium oxide) 520 מ"ג'. NRV% label-image-verified: 186%W/149%M = 520/280 and 520/350 respectively. Physical label image: altman520.webp (TASK-384).

7290017218564.note: 520mg IS elemental — NRV%-verified from physical label image. UL_EXCEED: 520mg > 350mg IOM/NASEM supplemental UL. Prior compound reading (314mg) REFUTED.
